activities.result: Interpret an ordinary-language request and choose the smallest valid direct, diagnostic, prioritization, or multi-domain route without forcing an uncertain lexical match.
Choose simple, power-user, or organization deployment; optionally separate organization-owned state from product source; and keep versioning/Obsidian as optional adapters.
Generate a traceable Markdown/Obsidian-friendly human view from canonical BusinessOS state without creating a competing truth store.
Discover important external changes, tactics, findings, and signals; verify what is real and relevant; and route promising items to investigation, testing, or learning.
Turn strong reusable Learning into a governed business process extension, new local playbook, or canonical BusinessOS revision candidate without overgeneralizing evidence.
Prepare, import, browse, and evaluate portable BusinessOS process innovations with explicit sharing consent and no required central service.
Separate community reports from independent/local evidence and route promising innovations to test, adopt, or playbook evolution.
Narrow a broad unexplained business symptom to evidence-backed likely mechanisms and correctly owned next work before intervention.
Turn a broad growth/prioritization goal into the highest-value next work supported by current evidence and installed modules.
Decompose and sequence one compound request across several semantic owners while preserving ownership, lineage, and efficient handoffs.
Create evidence-backed initial business context from minimal identity, first-party sources, and user-provided information.
Adaptively map owned/official business surfaces and evidence at the depth needed for the current job.
Capture durable brand voice, visual, content, channel, reference, and prohibited-style rules.
Query connected first-party business truth through the best governed/provider-neutral data surface and preserve evidence-linked BusinessOS references.
Turn an authorized business occurrence into a deduplicated BusinessOS evaluation trigger without bypassing routing or approval.
Configure an event-driven BusinessOS monitoring path only when provider runtime readiness and host delivery are actually available, with explicit fallback otherwise.
Explain and repair reason-coded reactive-event failures or no-action outcomes without guessing or unsafe replay.
